_comment: Client testimonials for the 'What clients say' carousel. The section stays HIDDEN until 'items' has at least one entry. Only add real words from real clients, with their permission. Fields: name (shown as written), role and quote (per language: en, fa, ps; an empty fa/ps falls back to English), organization (optional), photo (optional, a square image such as assets/testimonials/name.jpg; initials are shown without one). showExamples: true shows the clearly-marked example cards below while 'items' is empty, so you can see the design. Set it to false before launch.

quote.en: This is an example card. Your client's real words will appear here once you add them to data/testimonials.json.
Example: a sentence or two about the system you built, and what changed for their team after it went live.
Example: short and specific works best, such as the problem they had, how you solved it, and how it feels to use.
